title: Voice AI Skill Catalog
subtitle: A comprehensive blueprint for speech synthesis, recognition, conversational voice, production, safety, and delivery
source_note: Derived from the Voice AI Skill Catalog document (500 skill concepts across 50 categories). Descriptions are preserved verbatim from the source catalog.

tiers.elevated: Consent record, human approval and audit trail mandatory before delivery (voice cloning, datasets, healthcare, legal/evidentiary, biometrics).
tiers.review: Human review gate strongly recommended before delivery.
tiers.standard: Standard production workflow with normal human review.

construction_pattern: Define the voice task, trigger phrases, accepted inputs, output formats, and non-goals.
Specify language, locale, pronunciation, speaker authorization, emotion, speaking rate, latency, sample rate, channel layout, and delivery target.
Keep editable intermediate outputs such as normalized text, phonemes, timestamps, transcripts, stems, cue sheets, and approval records.
Use reference files for pronunciation, locales, safety policy, delivery profiles, provider contracts, and benchmark definitions.
Use deterministic scripts for analysis, conversion, segmentation, metadata, conformance, and regression tests.
End with listening review, technical measurement, consent and privacy review, accessibility checks, and clean-state handoff.
